detail.longDescription: Ping... Is this thing working? I moved the # Mastodon reverse proxy from # Nginx to # Caddy . I took this gist as a base: https:// gist.github.com/yukimochi/bb7c 90cbe628f216f821e835df1aeac1 , added some from @ neatnik 's answer to my previous post, and followed the Nginx config, because the paths in the gist were outdated. Now I don't need a separate IP for Mastodon and have my two most important services on a single host. Oh, and I can remove certbot from the Mastodon host! Nice =) # Homelab # Mastoadmin # selfhosted # selfhosting # selfHost
